desc: [2026-05-19]  Our group's paper "L^2Mersit: A Scaling-Free Sub-8-bit Data Format for On-Device Reliable Large Language Model Serving" has been accepted to ISLPED'26. Congratulations Myeongjin and Hyeonseong!

[2026-02-24]  Our group's paper "LOHA: A Latency-Optimized CPU-Storage Hybrid Architecture for Billion-Scale Graph-based Vector Similarity Search" has been accepted to DAC'26. Congratulations Seongjoon and Junyoung!
[2026-01-26]  Our group's paper "SERQ: Saliency-Aware Low-Rank Error Reconstruction for LLM Quantization" has been accepted to ICLR'26. Congratulations Yeonsik and Hyeonseong!

[2025-12-08]  Our group's paper "Q-VESA: Accelerating Quantization-Aware Vector Search for Fast Retrieval in Prompt Engineering" has been accepted to IEEE Transactions on Computers. Congratulations Seongjoon and Junyoung!

[2025-07-28]  Our group's paper "Accelerating On-Device Visual Task Adaptation by Exploiting Hybrid Sparsity in DNN Training" has been accepted to Journal of Systems Architecture. Congratulations Minje and Yeonsik!
[2025-06-24]  Three of our group's papers are presented at Summer Annual Conference of IEIE, 2025. Congratulations Junyoung, Yeonsik and Soomin!
[2025-03-01]  Junyoung, Yeonsik, Jiyun, Hyeonseong and Myeongjin have joined our group as graduate researchers. Welcome.

[2025-02-06]  Our group's paper "Precon: A Precision-Convertible Architecture for Accelerating Quantized Deep Learning Models across Various Domains Including LLMs" has been accepted to DAC'25. Congratulations Jongwoo, Hyeonseong and Jiyun!
[2024-10-21]  Our group's paper "PABLO: A Variation-Robust PIM Architecture for Bulk Bitwise Logical Operations in DRAM" has been accepted to IEEE Transactions on Emerging Topics in Computing.
[2024-10-17]  Our group's paper "A 33.06 Gb/s Reconfigurable Galois Field oFEC Decoder for Optical Inter-Satellite Communication" has been accepted to IEEE Solid-State Circuits Letters.
[2024-05-19]  Our group's paper "ParaBase: A Configurable Parallel Baseband Processor for Ultra-High-Speed Inter-Satellite Optical Communications" has been accepted to ISLPED'24. Congratulations!
[2024-03-11]  Yeonsik and Gyuwan have joined our group as undergraduate researchers. Welcome!
[2024-02-21]  Sungjun and Minje have joined our group as graduate research fellows. Welcome!
[2024-02-14]  Our group's paper "MERSIT: A Hardware-Efficient 8-bit Data Format with Enhanced Post-Training Quantization DNN Accuracy" has been accepted to DAC'24. Congratulations!
